Is this Mt. Hazakura~? There aren't many cherry\nblossoms here, but the scent of the new green\nleaves is so pleasant.
I thought it was gonna be kinda dark since he\nsaid it was a ninja village. If it looks like\nthis, I guess this journey is gonna be fun!
Alright, time to head into the ninja village~!
I think we've climbed quite high.\nIs Leafy Sakura Village still far~?
We might have taken it a little too lightly.\nWe have to find Leafy Sakura Village before it\ngets dark or things will get troublesome...
What's wrong? Did you see something?
??? Who are you?! You're about to enter the\nterritory of Leafy Sakura!
My gosh?! Funny, I was gonna ask the same thing.\nWho are you?!
Oh! Could you be...Princess Nanaka?
How come you know about me?
We were asked by Caylass to come here and hear\nwhat you have to say.
Caylass sent you here?!
That means you're here to check out the Leafy\nSakura Village and my abilities, then report it to\nCaylass, right?
I won't let you do that!!
W-wait a minute!!\nWe only came here to talk to you!!
Don't waste your breath!!
Ugh!
What?
Hmph, that was impressive...\nYou managed to fool me and make me trip...\nYou're definitely an expert!!
What are you talking about? You fell on your own.
Fine...\nYou can ask me whatever you want.
But in return, you gotta teach me some of your\nexpert moves!!
Expert moves? I don't think I know any, though.
Please!\nAt this rate, defeating Caylass is just a pipe\ndream!
That's what we wanna know.\nWhy do you want to defeat Caylass?
Alright, I'll tell you the story from the\nbeginning.
Exactly one year ago, Caylass showed up at our\nvillage...
Caylass, who was interested in ninjutsu, had his\neye on my father, Sandayu, who was the leader of\nthe Leafy Sakura Clan and an expert in ninjutsu...
Yeah, he told us something like that too.
Sandayu and the Leafy Sakura Clan are entrusted\nwith the task of secretly ensuring the safety of\nthis area, including the Sakura Garden.
That's what the Leafy Sakura's ninjutsu is for.\nUsing it just to compare or show off your power is\nwrong.
Hmm, I see~.
However, Caylass refused to give up and he came\nalmost every day to challenge my father to a\nduel...
Hmm...If that's what he wants, I don't think he'd\ngive up easily.
He'd hang around the village and make a lot of\nnoise. He'd start drinking in the afternoon, then\nget drunk and start acting violently...
He was a huge nuisance to everyone.
T-that's brutal...I know Caylass is kinda sassy,\nbut he wouldn't go that far, would he?!
...Well, yeah. Honestly, he might actually do\nsomething like that.
Eventually, Sandayu gave in and agreed to a duel\nusing ninjutsu.
The duel took place in the Sakura Garden and\nSandayu was defeated. Ashamed, my father\ndisappeared, and his whereabouts remain unknown...
I guess being pushy is just Caylass' thing.\nThat explains why he was beating around the bush\nwhen asked about the reason for the duel.
Now, I am leading the Leafy Sakura Clan in place\nof my father.
The first thing I swore to do is defeat Caylass to\nrestore my father and the Leafy Sakura's honor!!
...Uh, since you've heard the whole story,\nI'd like you to help me.
What~? Don't tell me you want us to train you as\nour apprentice?
I'd love that, but...I'll need to train for a long\ntime to master the skills of expert adventurers\nlike you. That made me think twice.
I don't think I have time for that right now.\nI need to defeat Caylass to restore my father and\nthe Leafy Sakura's honor as soon as possible.
Actually, since the leadership change happened so\nsuddenly, some villagers are unsure if I'm truly\nqualified for the role...
I see, so it hasn't been easy for you either.\nYou wanna defeat Caylass and prove to everyone\nthat you're a capable leader, right?
Yes...But for me, settling the score for my\nbeloved father is what matters the most...
That way, maybe he will come back to the village.\nI miss him so much...
Welp, now that we know Caylass is part of the\nproblem too, I guess it's fair if we help her,\nright?
Thank you very much!\nI knew I could count on you!\nMy instinct was right!
So, what should we do?
Next to Mt. Hazakura, you'll find Mt. Black Peach\nand Mt. White Peach.
There's a cave in each mountain. Our family's\nsecret treasures are hidden in the depths of those\ncaves.
If I can get those treasures, I'm sure I'll become\nstronger! I'd like you to help me get them!
Wait, treasures?! You mean real treasures?!\nWhy are you just telling us now?!
Forget all about Caylass! We need to focus all our\nenergy on helping Princess Nanaka now!
So, do we go to Black Peach or White Peach?!
Well, uh, first, I'd like you to go to\nMt. Black Peach. A secret legendary sword is\nhidden there.
Okay!\nTreasure...oops, I mean, Mt. Black Peach, here\nI come!!
Princess Nanaka~!\nWait!
Oh!\nDo you need anything from me?
Wait, you're okay? I thought you'd be sad!\nBecause you looked like you were about to cry back\nat the Night Sakura Garden!
Hehe, I don't know why either.
It's strange, but I just got this feeling that\nmy father will come back once I truly become\nthe leader of Leafy Sakura!
Oh well, if you're cool with it, then I guess\nthat's fine...
Oh, I forgot! Your reward!
Here! Thank you very much for everything!
And one more thing!\nThe official ceremony to inaugurate me as the\nleader of Leafy Sakura will take place!
If you don't mind, I would like you to attend it!
Oh?\nActually, formal events like that give me anxiety.
Please! I'd like to introduce you to everyone in\nthe village as the people who helped me the most\nto become a leader.
Well, in that case, I guess we could humor you.\n It's not like we're in a rush anyway.
Thank you!\nLet's go then!
By the way, does the Leafy Sakura Clan really not\nhave any other treasures?
Eh?\nNo, there's no other treasure.
Oh come on, there’s gotta be a special one you're\nkeeping, right?
As I said, there's really no more treasure!
You can't fool me, just cough it up already!\nI know you've got something stashed away, right?!
N-no, there's no such thing!
Hey, why are you stopping there?!\nWe need to go to Mt. Black Peach first, you know?!
